resources.string: Filtered French word list for new classic solo and same-device games.
Import a dictionary for offline practice games

Import a UTF-8 text file you have permission to use, with one word of 2 to 15 letters per line (up to 12 MiB). For tournament practice, use CSW24 (WESPA) or NWL2023 (NASPA). Your list stays on this device and applies to offline practice.
The dictionary could not be read or is too large. Check that it is a UTF-8 text file with one word of 2 to 15 letters per line.
Offline practice with your personal dictionary
Finish or leave the Bluetooth game before opening your personal dictionary.
Remove the list from this device? Import the same list again to recover its practice games.
